digest.component_or_area: completion close gate / plan-review gate documentation
propositions: When acceptance criteria no longer match reality, the completion-verification close gate blocks the close and offers no sanctioned path forward.
The correct remedy is to edit the ticket so criteria are accurate, re-pass plan review, then close against corrected criteria — not force-close or ref an old commit.
Closing against stale criteria via --force-close or an older --ref leaves inaccurate state in the shared ticket store.
This ticket is a short documentation fix to docs/plan-review-gate.md, explicitly rejecting an audited criterion-disposition subsystem as overbuilt.
A separate stale-regver check on the plan-review close gate forces a billable re-review of already-executed plans, stranding completed work.
Criteria invalidated by the fix itself or auto-generated/unverifiable criteria have no ref at which they can be verified.
